title: Why does AI confidently make stuff up? 🤖

beats.big:
Why does AI
lie with a
straight face?
beats.say: Why does AI make things up, with total confidence?
Because it's basically taking a multiple choice test. And a blank answer scores zero.

beats.sub: it doesn't know... but guesses anyway
beats.say: Ask it your birthday. If it says I don't know, it gets zero points.

beats.sub: a random date guess can still win
beats.say: But a random guess is right one time in three sixty five. So guessing wins.
OpenAI researchers say accuracy-only scoring rewards guessing over honesty.

beats.sub: wrong answers on a fact quiz
beats.say: On a fact quiz, a model that always guessed was wrong seventy five percent of the time. One that admits doubt? Twenty six.
The fix? Punish confident errors more than I don't know.
